name: Platform Evidence
description: Assessment of exact machine-resolvable property claims for a subject and, where applicable, a key. Evidence for one property cannot establish other properties. Display order grants no authority.

values.label: Unknown
values.description: Evaluation could not establish the requested claim in the stated scope.

values.label: Locally observed
values.description: A named local interface reports the properties.

values.label: Authority verified
values.description: Accepted external authority verifies the exact properties and subject.

values.label: Hardware attested
values.description: Verified hardware-rooted evidence covers the exact properties and subject.

examples.dataset: Evaluation occurred but applicable evidence was insufficient
